tools.name: book_brain_meeting
tools.description: Open the Brain booking page (30-minute call or callback request) in the current tab and return its URL and the contact email. Does not submit anything.

tools.name: find_brain_product
tools.description: Find which Brain products fit a need about employee cybersecurity or AI awareness (competition, awareness month, arcade kiosk, Slack bot, learning path, phishing simulation, deepfake experience). Returns product names, one-line descriptions and page URLs on startbrain.io.

need.description: The need or use case, in any language, e.g. "cybersecurity awareness month for 800 employees"

tools.name: get_brain_pricing
tools.description: Return where the public prices of Brain live (credit packs for Cyber Cup and Super Challenge, annual licence per Brain Arcade kiosk, events on quote), excluding VAT.

tools.name: list_brain_products
tools.description: List every Brain product with a one-line description and its page URL on startbrain.io, in the current site language.
